school.name: W. H. Maxwell Career and Technical Education High School
school.overview: William H. Maxwell Career and Technical Education High School is a Future Ready NYC school offering the best of college and career exploration. We now offer a CNA program, one of the fastest-growing and highest-paid industries in our city. However, we will prepare our students for work in any field, not just healthcare. Students will also explore a range of careers in Fashion, Graphic Design, Cosmetology and Barbering.  In these career areas, our students will acquire 21st-century employability skills including financial literacy, paid work-based learning opportunities, early college credits and credentials, and will graduate college and career ready.

programs.name: Design Technology (K68A)
programs.description:
Fashion: 
Maxwell offers a thorough fashion program that provides students with practical training in the techniques, skills, and terminology of Fashion Design and Accessories, covering the entire journey from concept to conception. Students can work alongside industry professionals. Students create garments following experience level and assign themes to participate in fashion shows, exhibits, as well as various parades in NYC.  Through their time in the program, they visit museums for archival fashion exhibitions, volunteer in fabric recycling centers, and intern with community designers or the schoolsâ design lab. 
Communications Media: 
Our comprehensive 2-year graphic design program immerses students in photography, illustration/drawing, and social media management. The curriculum culminates with students taking the Adobe Photoshop certification exam at the end of the 10th grade and the Adobe Premier Pro at the end of the 11th grade, validating their proficiency by receiving these industry-recognized certifications. Graduates emerge as versatile, industry-ready professionals equipped for the competitive field of graphic design.

programs.name: Medical Careers (K68C)
programs.description: Join Maxwellâs Nursing Program and launch your medical career with confidence. Our exceptional program is designed to fast-track your journey into nursing and beyond, providing a unique blend of academic and practical experiences that set you up for success. Graduate not only with a high school diploma but also with a Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) certificate, ready to step into the workforce immediately. Students are required to complete 108 hours of clinical patient care practical skills while also obtaining their CPR and NARCAN certificates, making you even more valuable to potential employers.

programs.name: Beauty Science & Technology (K68J)
programs.description: Are you ready for an exciting experience in the beauty world? The cosmetology and barbering courses provide students with their NYS license while preparing them for a fulfilling career. This program provides students with the opportunity of graduating with a CTE endorsed diploma while covering areas of cosmetology & barbering. The areas include business management, nail tech, natural hairstyling, skin care, fades, tapers, razor cutting and shaving, fantasy hairstyling, makeup, lashes, wigs, and much more! While in training students have an opportunity to participate in a paid internship and practice their skills on clients in the community.
